title: lunar-ir-data-tools: readers and corrections for Kaguya SP, Kaguya MI and Chandrayaan-2 IIRS data
description: Python readers and correction routines for lunar infrared spectrometer data: the Kaguya/SELENE Spectral Profiler Level 2C point spectra (PDS3), a footprint search through the JAXA DARTS PDAP service, a sampler for Kaguya Multiband Imager mosaics, and a Chandrayaan-2 IIRS PDS4 reader with single- and two-temperature thermal-emission removal for radiance-to-reflectance conversion.
